reason: Not refuted on the machine lens. Opcodes and modes are all real 65SC12 (BRA is the only 65C02 one; SBC zp, AND #, LDY zp, BCS/BRA relative). The carry from SBC screen_start_address_low reaches SBC screen_start_address_high: STA zp, LDA abs,X and STA abs,Y leave C alone; A on entry is movers_screen_address_low,X (the LDA before STA rec_sl,Y). wa_off+1 (&4A) is read nowhere in src/ or tools/ and no other symbol sits at &4A; dm_index (&67) is the only symbol at its address, both JMP record_live sites do LDY dm_index just before, and neither record_live nor world_of_address writes it, so LDY dm_index = the old PLY's Y. Recount, record_live path: old unique PHY 3, LDY abs,X 4, TAX 2, TYA 2, SEC 2, SBC zp 3, STA zp 3, TXA 2, SBC zp 3, AND 2, STA zp 3, PLY 4 = 33; new SEC 2, SBC 3, STA 3, SBC 3, AND 2, LDY zp 3 = 16: 17 saved (more if the removed LDY movers_screen_address_low,X crossed), +1 for the row test's untaken BCS = 18; list_live path 3 + 1 = 4; rare row-short path (~0.1 a pass) old BCC untaken 2 + INY 2 = 4, new BCS taken 3 + INY 2 + BRA 3 = 8 (BCS back to ~wofa-3 and BRA forward stay in page &A0, offsets ~-28 and small). ~2.03 + ~2.02 executions a pass: ~44 a pass before layout effects. Bytes: record_live +4 (14 vs 10), STA wa_off+1 -2, INY out of line +2 (BCS 2 + INY 1 + BRA 2 vs BCC 2 + INY 1): +4 bytes (the code grows by 4). Layout, checked in build/strykers.lst for everything after &A05F sliding 4 in bank 4 to &B36F (still under REN_BASE &B400): branches whose page crossing changes: only BEQ out at &A2F7 (sky_put_on's fall, 0.4 cycles a pass measured: ~+0.13); indexed reads: LDY wa_rows_guess,X crosses for X>=7 instead of 11 (~+0.25 a pass), ck_index ($A3B2->$A3B6) crosses for Y>=&4A instead of &4E (player sprite 4 flipped lines 2-5 only, +1 each, small), straight_sprite_hi's X >= &18 instead of &1C (read in ren_draw_sprite: +1 on 4 sprite numbers), wa_rows_base_lo/hi, sky_heights, sky_blk, sprite_column_count, ck_bank/draw/restore stay within their pages. The straight sprites' data (&A530-&B36F) slides 4 bytes, so LDA (d_ptr),Y / (col_ptr) crossings in draw_column change at the ~14 page boundaries in it, either way, a few cycles a pass at most: the gate's passbench must confirm, but none of these approaches the ~43 a pass saved. Self-modifying operands: none in the edited lines; mask_operand/pix_operand etc. are referenced by label and move with the assembler. Baron scope.label forward references (world_of_address.wa_hi_done_c2, .row_known) follow the existing mark_part.header_lo / put_on.going_on usage.
